title: Improve wear collection service when phone is out of range
body:
With the latest nightlies the wear collection service is started as soon as the smartwatch has no connection to the phone (only "Enable Wear Collection Service" is activated). It would be better if the wear collection service is already started when the phone cannot connect to the transmitter even if the watch is still connected to the phone.
I often noticed that the watch has a better bluetooth range than the transmitter. So the watch did not start collection service because it still had connection to the phone but the transmitter already lost connection to the phone. Due to this issue there are sometimes no readings received.

Collector device: Miaomiao
Watch: Ticwatch E
OS watch: Wear OS: 1.5 Android 8.0.0
Phone: Nexus 6P
OS phone: Android 8.1.0

comments.body:
I also have Ticwatch E but I could never collect reading from watch independently no matter what I tried.

My phone is Galaxy S8 though, any tips on how to do it?

@Bo7amada Do you use Miaomiao as collector? I also had some trouble to get the watch receiving data. Try to follow the "xDrip+ Wear Setup and Troubleshooting Guide". (https://github.com/jamorham/xDrip-plus/blob/master/Documentation/WatchGuide.md) Make sure all calibration plugins are disabled. Also "Show Noise workings" and "Smooth Sensor Noise" in the display settings should be disabled.
Before I received the first reading on the watch I had to enter an additional calibration on the phone (the log listed a "wearBgReading: No BG?" error).
Yes I'm on MaioMaio, I'll see the docs now, but did u patch ur watch or something?
